    FAQ
    Questions people ask
    Straight answers before you reach out.
    
  
    
    
    How is this different from a Wix or Squarespace site?
    You own it. I build your site from scratch around your business, so there are no monthly platform fees and no being stuck in a template. If you ever leave, you take your site with you.
    
    
    Is there a monthly fee?
    The build is a one-time price. The care plan is $50/month on every package and covers upkeep and small updates. You also pay for your own domain name, usually around $15 to $25 a year.
    
    
    How many revisions do I get?
    Startup Showcase includes 2 rounds, Business includes 3 and Pro includes 4. A round is one combined list of changes. Extra edits after that are $50/hour.
    
    
    What do I need to give you?
    Your business name, contact details, a few lines about what you do, and any photos or a logo you have. If something is missing, I will help you work around it.
    
    
    How fast can you launch?
    Startup Showcase usually takes 2 to 4 days, Business 4 to 7 days and Pro 2 to 3 weeks, once I have your information.
    
    
    What happens after launch?
    You get free fixes for anything that is not working: 14 days on Startup Showcase, 30 days on Business and 60 days on Pro. After that, the care plan keeps your site running.
    
    
    Does the sale price apply to me?
    Startup Showcase is $500 for the first 3 clients, and one spot is already taken, so 2 remain before it goes to $750. Claim your free design mockup to lock in your spot.

    Privacy Policy
    Last updated: October 12, 2026
    

    This policy explains how Forge ("Forge", "I", "me"), a web design business operated by Josh Jacobson in Spruce Grove, Alberta, Canada, collects, uses and protects personal information. It applies to this website, my contact form, phone, text, email and social media messages, and my work with clients.
    

    1. Information I collect
    

    What you give me: your name, business name, email address, phone number, the type of project you need and any message you send, through the contact form, email, text, phone or direct messages. If you become a client, I also receive the content you provide for your website, such as logos, photos, text and domain or hosting details.
    

    Testimonials: if you agree to share a review, I may publish your name, photo, quote and social media handle. I only do this with your permission.
    

    Automatic information: this website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. My hosting provider may keep basic technical logs, such as IP address, browser type and pages requested, to keep the site secure and running. The site loads fonts from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address and browser details when the page loads.
    

    2. How I use your information
    

    To reply to you, prepare free design mockups and quotes, build and maintain your website, provide support and care plans, send invoices and keep business records, improve this website, and meet legal obligations. I only send marketing messages if you ask for them or where the law allows, and every one will have a way to opt out.
    

    3. Who I share it with
    

    I do not sell your information. I use trusted service providers to run my business, including Formspree (which receives contact form submissions and forwards them to my email), my email provider, website hosting and domain providers, and payment services when used. They may only use your information to provide their services. I may also disclose information if required by law. Testimonials are public only with your permission.
    

    4. Storage outside Canada
    

    Some of these providers process or store information in other countries, including the United States, where local laws may apply.
    

    5. How long I keep it
    

    Enquiries from people who do not become clients are kept for up to 24 months. Client records are kept for as long as I provide services, and financial records are kept for six years as required by Canadian tax rules. After that, information is deleted or anonymized.
    

    6. Security
    

    I use reasonable safeguards, such as password-protected accounts and limited access, to protect your information. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, so I cannot guarantee absolute security.
    

    7. Your choices and rights
    

    You can ask to see the personal information I hold about you, correct it, withdraw your consent, or have it deleted, subject to legal and record-keeping requirements. Contact me using the details below and I will respond within a reasonable time.
    

    8. Client websites
    

    If I build a website that collects information from its visitors, you are responsible for that site's own privacy policy. I can help you add one.
    

    9. Third-party links
    

    This site links to other services, such as Instagram. Their own privacy policies apply once you leave this site.
    

    10. Children
    

    This site is for business owners and is not directed at children under 18. I do not knowingly collect information from children.
    

    11. Changes to this policy
    

    I may update this policy and will change the date above when I do.
    

    12. Contact and complaints
    

    Josh Jacobson, Forge, Spruce Grove, Alberta
    Email: josh.forge.co@gmail.com
    Phone: 780-919-5849
    

    I handle personal information in line with Alberta's Personal Information Protection Act and Canada's PIPEDA, as they apply. If I cannot resolve a concern, you may contact the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Alberta or the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.
    

    Terms of Use and Service
    Last updated: October 12, 2026
    

    1. Using this website
    This site is for general information about Forge's services. Its content, design and code belong to Forge and may not be copied or reused without permission. It is provided as is, without warranties.
    

    2. Pricing and sales
    All prices are in Canadian dollars. Sale pricing applies to the first 3 businesses that inquire on each package, while that offer is available, and I may end it at any time. Comparisons with other agencies show typical starting prices and may vary. Add-ons and anything outside a package are quoted before work starts. Payment terms are agreed in writing before work begins.
    

    3. Revisions and timelines
    Startup Showcase includes 2 revision rounds, Business includes 3 and Pro includes 4. A round is one combined list of changes. Extra edits are $50 per hour. Timelines are estimates and depend on you providing your content and feedback promptly. After launch, I fix anything that is not working for free: 14 days on Startup Showcase, 30 days on Business and 60 days on Pro.
    

    4. Ownership
    Once your project is paid in full, you own your website and its content. You promise that anything you give me, such as logos, photos and text, is yours to use. Unless you ask me not to, I may show completed work and testimonials in my portfolio and marketing.
    

    5. Domains and third-party costs
    Your domain name is registered in your name and paid for by you. Any third-party tools or services you choose are billed by those providers.
    

    6. Care plan
    The monthly care plan covers hosting set-up and monitoring, security and software updates, backups, support and a set number of small edits as described on this site. You can cancel at any time by contacting me before your next billing date, and you keep your website.
    

    7. Limits of liability
    To the extent the law allows, Forge is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost sales or profits. Total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the service in question.
    

    8. Governing law
    These terms are governed by the laws of Alberta and the federal laws of Canada that apply there.
